verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at poke.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. Other agent-oriented formats are absent: docs.md and the OpenAPI paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers the docs in depth (API, MCP, recipes) rather than a summary, markdown versions of docs pages, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
